title: iRacing Ferrari GT3 Indy Road Guide 1:22.8 Ferrari 296 GT3 Indianapolis Track Guide

corners.braking: Brake at midway between 500 and 400, straight on brakes to 65%, then to 0% before 1 marker, down to 1st gear
corners.line: Turn-in at marker, apex at marker, cut right side
corners.exit: Lift to 15-20%, then smoothly back on gas, flat out
corners.mistakes: Never reach 100%, stay on right side

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Brake at car's width from exit of turn three, up to 35%
corners.exit: Back on gas at apex, nearly full throttle

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: brake to 65% at grass inlet, trail off
corners.line: cut grass, lift over curb, turn in at end of curve
corners.exit: accelerate at apex, 30% brake to 10-15% at turn 8, trail off
corners.mistakes: do not miss the braking marker, cut the corner

corners.braking: Brake at 400 marker, 60% pressure to 100 marker, trail off at apex.
corners.line: Avoid local curb, lift in darker patch, brake at 40%, trail off, point nose in.

general_tips: Enjoy additional speed all the way down the back straight
cut the corner to use the inside of the track
